# Method GetWcsFrameGeometry

#### GetWcsFrameGeometry(ElementId)

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 16, 400, 80)]

```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- |
